transcript.en: And today we're going to be bringing you a very useful lesson about being sick.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家带来一节关于生病的非常实用的课程。

transcript.en: We're going to learn how to tell your boss that you can't go to work because you're sick.
transcript.zh: 我们要学习如何告诉老板你因为生病不能去上班。

transcript.en: This is really important because we all get sick and sometimes you just can't go to work.
transcript.zh: 这真的很重要，因为我们都会生病，有时候就是没法去上班。

transcript.en: Or maybe sometimes you just don't want to go to work.
transcript.zh: 或者有时候你只是不想去上班。

transcript.en: But we're going to be teaching you how to do it anyway.
transcript.zh: 但无论如何我们都会教你怎么做。

transcript.en: So before we start with our dialogue, let's take a look at vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 所以在我们开始对话之前，先来看看词汇预览。

transcript.en: In this vocabulary preview, we have two words for you.
transcript.zh: 这次的词汇预览我们有两个词给你。

transcript.en: The first one is quite ill.
Quite is a synonym of very.
transcript.zh: Quite 是 very 的同义词。

transcript.en: So they both mean the same thing.
I just think ill is more common in British English.
transcript.zh: 我只是觉得 ill 在英式英语中更常见。

transcript.en: Let's take a look at our second word.
So the flu is a virus.
transcript.zh: 所以 flu 是一种病毒。

transcript.en: And it's very similar to a cold.
Yes, but just a lot worse.
So let's listen to our dialogue.
What's going to happen here today?
Well, we're going to listen as Julie calls her boss to tell him she's sick.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们要听朱莉打电话给老板说她生病了。

transcript.en: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
transcript.zh: 其实，我今天感觉很不舒服。

transcript.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
I think I'm coming down with the flu.
I have a headache, a sore throat, a runny nose, and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
transcript.zh: 我头疼、喉咙痛、流鼻涕，还有点发烧的感觉。
所以你是打电话请病假。

transcript.en: I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
transcript.zh: 我想请一天假休息恢复。

transcript.en: Okay, then try and get some rest.
So Julie didn't really seem to be sick, huh?
transcript.zh: 好的，朱莉看起来不太像真的生病了，嗯？

transcript.en: That cough was just a little too much.
It seemed like she was acting.
So let's take a look at some of this vocabulary in language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 让我们来看看这些词汇，在「语言要点」环节。

transcript.en: We have five words for you here, and these are all great words to describe a sickness, right?
transcript.zh: 我们为你们准备了五个词，这些都是描述生病的好词，对吧？

transcript.en: So when you have a headache, you have a sore head, right?
transcript.zh: 所以当你有 headache 的时候，你的头很痛，对吧？

transcript.en: It's the way you feel after being at the bar too late.
transcript.zh: 这就是你在酒吧待到很晚后的感觉。

transcript.en: When you drink too much, you get a headache.
Let's take a look at our next word.
So basically we have two words here.
Let's look at the first one.
Well, you know, it's the part right here at the back.
transcript.zh: 嗯，就是后面这里的这部分。

transcript.en: Well, it's the part at the back of your mouth that goes down to your stomach.
transcript.zh: 嗯，就是嘴巴后面通向胃的那部分。

transcript.en: So you use your throat to swallow.
Now we can use the word sore with different body parts, right?
transcript.zh: 现在我们可以用 sore 这个词跟不同的身体部位搭配，对吧？

transcript.en: Or maybe you were playing tennis all weekend, so you have a sore arm.
transcript.zh: 或者也许你整个周末都在打网球，所以你的手臂很酸痛。

transcript.en: Let's take a look at our third word.
This is a very strange word.
transcript.zh: 这是一个非常奇怪的词。

transcript.en: But it doesn't mean that your nose is running, right?
transcript.zh: 但不是说你的鼻子在跑步，对吧？

transcript.en: No, but when you have a runny nose, there's lots of water coming out of your nose, right?
transcript.zh: 不，但当你 runny nose 的时候，有好多水从你鼻子里流出来，对吧？

transcript.en: So it's interesting though, because when you run, you go fast, right?
transcript.zh: 有趣的是，因为 run 是快跑，对吧？

transcript.en: So a lot of water is coming fast out of your nose.
transcript.zh: 所以好多水从你鼻子里快速流出来。

transcript.en: Our fourth word today, slightly feverish.
So again, slightly is a little bit.
Well, let's break this word down.
So when your body is very, very hot because you're sick.
transcript.zh: 就是你生病时身体非常非常热。

transcript.en: So feverish is the feeling of your body being very, very hot.
transcript.zh: 所以 feverish 就是你身体感觉非常非常热的感觉。

transcript.en: So you have a high temperature.
It's not that you have a high temperature, but you feel like you have a high temperature.
And our last word, to recover.
So this means to get better, right?
transcript.zh: 所以这个意思是变好，对吧？

transcript.en: Can you only use it when you're sick?
So when you recover, you get better and you rest.
transcript.zh: 当你 recover 的时候，你变好并休息。

transcript.en: So maybe you can say, I was so busy this week.
I need to recover this weekend.
transcript.zh: 我需要这个周末恢复一下。

transcript.en: So yeah, if you feel tired or you feel sick, you can recover.
transcript.zh: 所以如果你觉得累或者觉得生病了，你可以 recover。

transcript.en: Let's listen to our dialogue again and we can listen to these words that we've just talked about.
transcript.zh: 让我们再听一遍对话，听听我们刚讲过的这些词。

transcript.en: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
transcript.zh: 其实，我今天感觉很不舒服。

transcript.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
I think I'm coming down with the flu.
I have a headache, a sore throat, a runny nose, and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
transcript.zh: 我头疼、喉咙痛、流鼻涕，还有点发烧的感觉。
所以你是打电话请病假。

transcript.en: I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
transcript.zh: 我想请一天假休息恢复。

transcript.en: Okay, then try and get some rest.
In this dialogue, we listen to some really interesting phrases of how you can tell your boss that you are feeling sick, right?
transcript.zh: 在这个对话中，我们听到了一些非常有趣的短语，关于如何告诉你老板你感觉不舒服，对吧？

transcript.en: So let's look at these in Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 让我们在「流利表达」中看看这些。

transcript.en: Okay, let's take a look at our first phrase on Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来看流利表达的第一个短语。

transcript.en: So let's listen to some examples and then we'll come back and explain this interesting phrase.
transcript.zh: 我们先听几个例子，然后回来解释这个有趣的短语。

transcript.en: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
Are you coming down with the flu?
I think I'm coming down with something.
transcript.zh: 我想我可能是要生病了。

transcript.en: Okay, so basically coming down with means.
transcript.zh: 好，所以基本上 coming down with 意思是开始生病。

transcript.en: Okay, so you can use it with.
I'm coming down with the flu.
I'm coming down with a cold.
I'm coming down with a cough.
Yeah, or I'm coming down with something.
transcript.zh: 嗯，或者说我快要得什么病了。

transcript.en: You don't know what it is.
Okay, let's take a look at our second phrase.
transcript.zh: 好的，让我们看第二个短语。

transcript.en: You know, when you say I'm calling in sick, you're saying, hey, I'm not going to come to work today because I am sick.
transcript.zh: 你知道，当你说 I'm calling in sick，你是在说，嘿，我今天因为生病不去上班了。

transcript.en: Okay, so literally it means that you call your office and you say you're not going to work.
transcript.zh: 好的，字面意思就是打电话到办公室说你今天不去上班。

transcript.en: Yes, but it's great because it's three words that show such a long idea.
transcript.zh: 是的，但它的好处在于三个词就表达了一个这么长的意思。

transcript.en: Right, because otherwise you would have to say I'm calling because I don't feel well, so I'm not going to go to work.
transcript.zh: 对，因为否则你得说「我打电话是因为我感觉不舒服，所以我不去上班了」。

transcript.en: Yes, but if you say I'm calling in sick, everyone knows.
transcript.zh: 是的，但如果你说 I'm calling in sick，所有人都明白。

transcript.en: That you're not going to go to work.
Okay, now let's take a look at our last phrase.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在看最后一个短语。

transcript.en: Now this is a great phrase.
transcript.zh: 现在这是一个很棒的短语。

transcript.en: To take the day off is to?
transcript.zh: Take the day off 意思是？

transcript.en: Now you can say take the week off.
transcript.zh: 现在你也可以说 take the week off。

transcript.en: Take the month off or take the year off.
transcript.zh: Take the month off 或者 take the year off。

transcript.en: All right, so take the day off means to not go to work on that day.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以 take the day off 意思是那天不去上班。

transcript.en: All right, let's listen to our dialogue again now and then we'll come back and talk a little bit more.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们现在再听一遍对话，然后回来再聊一会儿。

transcript.en: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
transcript.zh: 其实，我今天感觉很不舒服。

transcript.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
I think I'm coming down with the flu.
I have a headache, a sore throat, a runny nose, and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
transcript.zh: 我头疼、喉咙痛、流鼻涕，还有点发烧的感觉。
所以你是打电话请病假。

transcript.en: Yes, I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
transcript.zh: 我想请一天假休息恢复。

transcript.en: Okay, then try and get some rest.
Well, Marco, have you ever done what Julie did?
transcript.zh: 嗯，马可，你有没有做过朱莉做的事？

transcript.en: Did you ever call your boss to say you're sick when you're not really?
transcript.zh: 你有没有在不真的生病时打电话给老板说你生病了？

transcript.en: I mean, sometimes you just don't feel very well, but you're not really sick.
transcript.zh: 有时候你就是感觉不太好，

transcript.en: You just don't feel like going to work.
Or sometimes you have something to do, right?
transcript.zh: 或者有时候你有别的事要做，对吧？

transcript.en: You know what we call those in Canada?
transcript.zh: 你知道在加拿大我们怎么称呼这个吗？

transcript.en: So you say, oh, I'm going to take a personal day, meaning I'm going to call in sick, but then go shopping.
transcript.zh: 所以你说，哦，我要请一个 personal day，意思是我要打电话请病假，但其实是去逛街。

transcript.en: We used to do that a lot because, for example, soccer games are such a big deal.
transcript.zh: 我们以前经常这样，因为比如足球比赛是非常重要的事。

transcript.en: And sometimes you would have a soccer match between, I don't know, Brazil, and it would be maybe at 10 a.m. or 11 a.m.
transcript.zh: 有时候会有一场足球赛，巴西对什么的，

transcript.en: So everyone would call in sick on that day.
transcript.zh: 所以那天每个人都会打电话请病假。

transcript.en: So the boss at least could plan that he would have an empty office.
transcript.zh: 所以老板至少能预料到办公室会空着。

transcript.en: Or sometimes you would take half the day off.
transcript.zh: 或者有时候你只请半天假。

transcript.en: So you would just go, you say, well, I'm not going to make it in the morning, but I'll come in the afternoon.
transcript.zh: 所以你会说，嗯，我上午来不了，但我下午再来。

transcript.en: So you would recover very quickly.
I'm feeling a little bit sick, but I'm going to be better in the afternoon.
transcript.zh: 我感觉有一点点不舒服，但下午就会好了。

transcript.en: So, well, if you have any questions or comments, please come to our website.
transcript.zh: 如果你们有任何问题或评论，请来我们的网站。

transcript.en: And if you have any calling in sick stories, please let us know.
transcript.zh: 如果你们有任何请病假的故事，请告诉我们。

transcript.en: You can visit us at EnglishPod.com and Marco and I are always there to answer your questions.
transcript.zh: 你可以访问 EnglishPod.com，马可和我一直都在那里回答你们的问题。

transcript.en: So we'll see you next time.

dialogue.en: A: Hello, Daniel speaking, how may I help you?
dialogue.zh: A：你好，我是丹尼尔，有什么可以帮您？

dialogue.en: A: Hi, Julie, how are you?
B: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
dialogue.zh: B：说实话，我今天感觉很不舒服。

dialogue.en: A: I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong?
dialogue.zh: A：很抱歉听到这个。怎么不舒服？

dialogue.en: B: I think I'm coming down with the flu. I have a headache, a sore throat a runny nose and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
dialogue.zh: B：我想我可能得流感了。我头疼、喉咙痛、流鼻涕，还有点发烧的感觉。

dialogue.en: A: I see... so you're calling in sick?
dialogue.zh: A：我明白了……所以你这是请病假？

dialogue.en: B: Yes, I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
dialogue.zh: B：是的，我想休息一天恢复一下。

dialogue.en: A: OK, then. Try and get some rest.
